Batch 72 is authored. The A page contains the projected operators, two local prerequisite lemmas, their commutators, and the Fock lift. The B page proves the finite-width spin bound and that an exact conical mode is not normalizable.

All six items have current Step 1 `ready` records. This records authoring readiness, not independent proof approval.

**Scoped checks passed:** precheck 6/6; proof layout 6 items and 24 steps with 0 defects; strict proof contracts 6/6; coverage checklist 0 errors; content policy 0 errors; dependency check 0 errors; rendercheck passed on all 8 assigned files. The scoped item levels are 2–6, with no cycles.

The source ledger records the Dereziński notes route as dropped after both hostnames timed out on the initial fetch and five retries each. I read the relevant sections through the [author’s current mirror](https://users.fuw.edu.pl/~derezins/qft-lectures.pdf); the local Fock proof and published exact-domain supplier cover those claims. The final source check reports 4/5 sources fetch-verified and 5/5 resolved, including that documented drop.

**Run-wide blockers remain outside batch 72:** item-level checking reports 124 empty unworked page inventories and two unrelated level mismatches: `ex-gr-fx14-1` (3 recorded, 4 computed) and `lem-nrqmx-finite-symplectic-implementers` (2 recorded, 1 computed). Full-run contract coverage stops at the empty `qsmx-modular-equilibrium` inventory. The stored batch schedule digest is stale after this manifest update, though the recorded and recomputed batch-72 level both remain 1, requiring batch 71. I left shared scheduling state unchanged.
